title: Refined convergence structures of the rectangular Raviart-Thomas element
summary: In this work, we fully explore three refined convergence structures of the lowest-order rectangular Raviart-Thomas element in solving the Laplace eigenvalue problem. Firstly, the scheme possesses a property of supercloseness between the discrete eigenfunctions and the interpolated ones, so that post-processing can be easily constructed to improve the accuracy at most by one order. The essentially skillful method is the integral expansion for interpolation terms.
